title: Initiative Card Schema
description: JSON Schema for Initiative-level ROM estimation and strategic scoping cards

product.description: Product from taxonomy (e.g., WebApp, MobileApp, API Platform)

module.description: Module from taxonomy (e.g., Notifications, Authentication, Billing)

client.description: Client from taxonomy (e.g., Acme Corp, Multi-Client, Internal)

estimate_hours.description: Estimated hours from engineering estimation session

jira_card.description: Link to Jira epic or initiative

source_intake.description: Reference to intake form filename (without extension)

source_conversation.description: Link to intake document or planning conversation

children.description: List of child epic filenames (without extension)

description.description: Condensed version of Background + Proposed Solution (2-3 sentences max)

updated.description: Last update date in YYYY-MM-DD format
